Khu Thú Ăn Thịt.name: Carnivore Zone
Khu Thú Ăn Thịt.description: This zone houses carnivorous animals such as lions, Bengal white tigers, Indochinese tigers and leopards.

Khu Chuồng Voi.name: Elephant Enclosure
Khu Chuồng Voi.description: The elephants live in a spacious enclosure near the giraffes, beside the river.

Khu Vực Linh Trưởng & Thú Nhỏ.name: Primates and Small Mammals
Khu Vực Linh Trưởng & Thú Nhỏ.description: This zone is home to monkeys, gibbons and active small mammals.

Khu Bò Sát.name: Reptile Zone
Khu Bò Sát.description: See pythons, snakes, crocodiles and tropical turtles in this zone.

Vườn Lan & Xương Rồng.name: Orchid and Cactus Garden
Vườn Lan & Xương Rồng.description: Located to the left of the main stage, this green garden is a popular place to take photographs.

Khu Vui Chơi Giải Trí (Đu Quay).name: Amusement Zone
Khu Vui Chơi Giải Trí (Đu Quay).description: This zone offers amusement rides and outdoor activities for children.
